_note: THE SAME PROBE AS media-fullpage-library, DRIVEN INTO THIS STATE BY REAL
CLICKS. `viewMode` is AssetGrid's own state and `selectedKeys` is
useSelectionState's; neither is a prop, so a fixture that forced them
would be measuring the fixture. The recipe clicks the List toggle and then
two row checkboxes, which is what a user does, and waits on the BULK BAR —
a state that only exists once something is selected, so a run where the
clicks silently missed cannot pass.
BOARD WON — the bulk bar and the list, and both were the same mistake:
1163:4875  the bulk bar is a 6-radius accent-tint BLOCK on a 12/8 pad
with a 10 gap, inside the grid column's own 12 rhythm. It
shipped as a full-bleed 29-high strip with an accent rule
beneath it — a second toolbar under the first.
1163:4882  the list header is 12/6 padded at 10px, not a 24-high rule
at 11.
1163:4888 / 1163:4900  the rows are 12/8 padded on a 6 radius, and the
selected ones are filled rather than ruled. Every row was a
FIXED 29 with a hairline under it — and the fixed height is
again why the board's 8 was never applied: a height and a
padding are different properties, so nothing conflicted and
nothing won. Third surface in this batch with that exact
cause (the picker's view toggle, the replace-across footer).
1163:4891 / 1163:4893  Type / Size / Usage are 10px, not 11.
NOT JOINED: 1163:4889 and the other per-row cells that carry a fixed
`width` (24 / 300 / 60 / 80) — those are the board's own column track
widths inside an 820 column, and the product's grid template distributes
1fr to the name; the COLUMNS are conformed (24px / 1fr / 64 / 88 / 88 on a
12 gap) but a text node's measured width is the track's, not the cell's.
1163:4890's `height: 13` is a text frame's line box, not a row height.
The rail, topbar, toolbar and status bar are the shared chassis and are
measured on media-fullpage-library; only what is NEW on this board is
joined here, so one fix cannot report itself five times.
CONTRAST, BOARD-MANDATED AND DECLARED — 7 failures at 4.38:1, every one of
them --bk-ink-muted on --bk-accent-tint, and both halves are the board's:
1163:4888 fills a SELECTED row with --color/bg-selected #EBF5FF and
1163:4891 / 1163:4892 / 1163:4893 put its Type / Size / Usage cells in
--color/ink-muted; 1163:4875 and 1163:4881 pair the same two on the bulk
bar's '✕ Clear'. Conforming cannot fix it — it is the ink-muted-on-tint
token defect (CONTRAST-INK-MUTED.md) on a second ground. Unselected rows
are white and pass at 4.83. The fix is one step darker on the secondary
cells (--bk-ink-soft is 6.9 on accent-tint), which deviates from a board
that names the token, so it is a founder call rather than a silent edit.
